text:
Predicates:
RosesGiven(x) ::: roses are given out on x.
OnTV(x) ::: x is on TV.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
Portrays(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTV(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
TimeSlot(x, t) ::: x occurs at time t.
Premises:
∃t (TimeSlot(monday8pm, t) ∧ RosesGiven(t) ∧ OnTV(t)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (RosesGiven(x) ∧ OnTV(x) → OnBachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → Portrays(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (Portrays(x) → RealityTV(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTV(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
TimeSlot(breakingBad, monday8pm) ::: Breaking Bad is on Monday at 8 pm.
